post.text:
Our Director-General, Chief Clinical Advisor for Rural Health, and Policy Analyst represented the Ministry at the WONCA World Rural Health Conference in Wellington. Rural WONCA is a global forum that brought together 978 health professionals and advocates from around the world.

Learn more below.
